## Specification

### Component: Slider

Pick a value or a range on a track. Built with pointer events and pointer capture; thumbs are `role="slider"`. A value bubble shows while dragging or keyboard-focused.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-slider" data-orientation data-tooltip [data-disabled] [data-dragging]  role="group" only when 2+ thumbs>
  <div class="ui-slider-track" aria-hidden><div class="ui-slider-range" style="--ui-p-start;--ui-p-end" [data-single]></div></div>
  <div class="ui-slider-thumb" role="slider" tabindex="0" style="--ui-p: 0–1" [data-dragging]>
    <span class="ui-slider-tooltip" aria-hidden>value text</span>
  </div>
  (one thumb per value)
  <input type="hidden" name value>   one per thumb when `name` is set
</div>
```
- Math lives in `slider-math.ts` (pure): `snapToStep`, `pointerToRatio`, `nearestThumb`, `setThumbValue`, `keyToValue`.

#### Props
- `value` / `defaultValue` (default `[min]`) / `onValueChange(number[])` — controlled or uncontrolled. `onValueCommit(number[])` fires when a drag ends or a key changes the value.
- `min` 0, `max` 100, `step` 1, `minStepsBetweenThumbs` 0, `orientation` `horizontal` · `vertical`, `disabled`, `name`.
- `formatValue(v)` → bubble text and `aria-valuetext`; `thumbLabels` (default "Minimum"/"Maximum" for two thumbs, "Value n" otherwise); `tooltip` `auto` · `always` · `never`.
- `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`: on the thumb for a single slider, on the group for a range.

#### Behaviour
- Pointer down on a thumb grabs it and keeps the grab offset (no jump). Pointer down on the track moves the nearest thumb there (ties: the thumb that can move toward the pointer) and starts a drag. Pointer is captured on the root; the thumb is focused.
- Value: thumb centre travels `length − thumb size`; ratio → value → snapped to `min + k·step` (float-safe) → clamped between neighbouring thumbs (+ `minStepsBetweenThumbs`). Thumbs never cross.
- Vertical: value 0 at the bottom; Up increases.
- Keys (on the thumb): →/↑ +step, ←/↓ −step, PageUp/PageDown ±≈10% of the range (a multiple of step), Home/End → min/max (or the neighbour limit).
- Thumb `aria-valuemin`/`valuemax` are the neighbours' values in a range.

#### Visual rules
- Root height 20px (the thumb) horizontal; vertical: 20px wide, 12rem tall default. `touch-action: pan-y` (vertical: `pan-x`), `user-select: none`.
- Track 6px, full radius, `--ui-control-track`; fill `--ui-control-on` (single: from the track start; range: between the thumbs' centres).
- Thumb 20px circle, 2px `--ui-control-on` border, `--ui-control-thumb` fill, `--ui-shadow-xs`. Position set with layout (`left`/`bottom` via `--ui-p`), never animated, so it tracks the pointer exactly.
- Bubble: `--ui-primary` fill, `--ui-primary-foreground` 12px/500 tabular numbers, `--radius-sm`, 4px 8px padding, 8px above the thumb (vertical: to the right).
- Disabled: opacity .5, `cursor: not-allowed`.

#### Motion
- Thumb `scale` 1 → 1.12 while dragging (1.06 hover on fine pointers) on `--ui-spring-snappy`.
- Bubble: opacity 0 → 1, `translate` 4px → 0, blur 2px → 0; 220ms `--ui-ease-out` in, 150ms `--ui-ease-in` out.
- Reduced motion: no movement; state still changes.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA slider and multi-thumb slider: `role="slider"`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext`, `aria-valuemin/max`, `aria-orientation`; two-thumb sliders sit in a labelled `role="group"`.
- Focus ring on `:focus-visible`: `0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Drag with a mouse and touch; click on the track jumps the nearest thumb; keyboard changes by step.
- Range thumbs cannot cross; `aria-valuenow` and bubble text match.
- Form values appear as hidden inputs; vertical works; light, dark, every accent; 390px width.

### `ui/components/slider/slider-math.ts`

```ts
/** Pure value math for Slider — no DOM, so it is unit-tested directly. */

export const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

/** Number of decimals in a number (handles `1e-7` notation). */
export function decimalCount(n: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
  const [mantissa = '', exponent] = String(n).split('e');
  const decimals = (mantissa.split('.')[1] ?? '').length;
  return Math.max(0, decimals - (exponent ? Number(exponent) : 0));
}

/** Snap to the nearest `min + k * step` inside [min, max], free of float noise (0.1 + 0.2). */
export function snapToStep(value: number, min: number, max: number, step: number): number {
  const clamped = clamp(value, min, max);
  const stepped = Math.round((clamped - min) / step) * step + min;
  const decimals = Math.max(decimalCount(step), decimalCount(min));
  return clamp(Number(stepped.toFixed(decimals)), min, max);
}

/** 0–1 position of a value on the track. */
export const valueToRatio = (value: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  max === min ? 0 : clamp((value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1);

/** Value (unsnapped) at a 0–1 position. */
export const ratioToValue = (ratio: number, min: number, max: number) => min + clamp(ratio, 0, 1) * (max - min);

/**
 * 0–1 position of a pointer along the track. The thumb centre travels only
 * `trackLength - thumbSize`, so the pointer is measured against that span.
 * `grabOffset` is how far from the thumb centre the pointer grabbed it.
 */
export function pointerToRatio({
  pointer,
  trackStart,
  trackLength,
  thumbSize,
  vertical = false,
  grabOffset = 0,
}: {
  pointer: number;
  trackStart: number;
  trackLength: number;
  thumbSize: number;
  vertical?: boolean;
  grabOffset?: number;
}): number {
  const span = trackLength - thumbSize;
  if (span <= 0) return 0;
  const along = (pointer - grabOffset - trackStart - thumbSize / 2) / span;
  return clamp(vertical ? 1 - along : along, 0, 1);
}

/** Index of the thumb closest to `value`; on a tie, the one that can move toward `value`. */
export function nearestThumb(values: number[], value: number): number {
  let best = 0;
  let bestDistance = Infinity;
  values.forEach((v, i) => {
    const distance = Math.abs(v - value);
    if (distance < bestDistance || (distance === bestDistance && value > v)) {
      best = i;
      bestDistance = distance;
    }
  });
  return best;
}

/** Return `values` with thumb `index` moved to `next`, kept between its neighbours and on the step grid. */
export function setThumbValue(
  values: number[],
  index: number,
  next: number,
  { min, max, step, minStepsBetweenThumbs = 0 }: { min: number; max: number; step: number; minStepsBetweenThumbs?: number },
): number[] {
  const gap = minStepsBetweenThumbs * step;
  const lower = index > 0 ? values[index - 1]! + gap : min;
  const upper = index < values.length - 1 ? values[index + 1]! - gap : max;
  const snapped = snapToStep(next, min, max, step);
  const bounded = clamp(snapped, Math.min(lower, upper), Math.max(lower, upper));
  if (bounded === values[index]) return values;
  const out = values.slice();
  out[index] = bounded;
  return out;
}

/** Keyboard value for a key, or `undefined` if the key does nothing. */
export function keyToValue(
  key: string,
  current: number,
  { min, max, step, lowerBound = min, upperBound = max }: { min: number; max: number; step: number; lowerBound?: number; upperBound?: number },
): number | undefined {
  const page = Math.max(step, Math.round((max - min) / step / 10) * step);
  switch (key) {
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'ArrowUp':
      return current + step;
    case 'ArrowLeft':
    case 'ArrowDown':
      return current - step;
    case 'PageUp':
      return current + page;
    case 'PageDown':
      return current - page;
    case 'Home':
      return lowerBound;
    case 'End':
      return upperBound;
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

export const sameValues = (a: number[], b: number[]) => a.length === b.length && a.every((v, i) => v === b[i]);
```

### `ui/components/slider/slider.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { clamp, keyToValue, nearestThumb, pointerToRatio, ratioToValue, sameValues, setThumbValue, valueToRatio } from './slider-math';

export type SliderOrientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
export type SliderTooltip = 'auto' | 'always' | 'never';

export interface SliderProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  /** Thumb values (controlled). One number is a single slider, two is a range. */
  value?: number[];
  /** Initial values when uncontrolled. Default `[min]`. */
  defaultValue?: number[];
  /** Called on every change while dragging or using the keyboard. */
  onValueChange?: (value: number[]) => void;
  /** Called once when a drag ends or a key press changes the value. Use it to save. */
  onValueCommit?: (value: number[]) => void;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  /** Minimum distance between range thumbs, in steps. Default 0. */
  minStepsBetweenThumbs?: number;
  /** `vertical` needs a height (default 12rem); value 0 sits at the bottom. */
  orientation?: SliderOrientation;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Form field name; one hidden input per thumb. */
  name?: string;
  /** Text for the tooltip and `aria-valuetext`, e.g. `(v) => '$' + v`. */
  formatValue?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Accessible names per thumb in a range. Default "Minimum" / "Maximum". */
  thumbLabels?: string[];
  /** Value bubble: `auto` shows it while dragging or focused with the keyboard. */
  tooltip?: SliderTooltip;
}

const defaultFormat = (v: number) => String(v);

/**
 * Slider — single value or range, built on pointer events with pointer
 * capture. Thumbs are `role="slider"` and follow the WAI-ARIA slider
 * (and multi-thumb slider) pattern. Controlled or uncontrolled.
 */
export const Slider = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SliderProps>(function Slider(
  {
    value,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    onValueCommit,
    min = 0,
    max = 100,
    step = 1,
    minStepsBetweenThumbs = 0,
    orientation = 'horizontal',
    disabled,
    name,
    formatValue = defaultFormat,
    thumbLabels,
    tooltip = 'auto',
    className,
    style,
    onPointerDown,
    onPointerMove,
    onPointerUp,
    onPointerCancel,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [raw, setRaw] = useControllableState<number[]>({ value, defaultValue: defaultValue ?? [min], onChange: onValueChange });
  const values = raw.map((v) => clamp(v, min, max));
  const multi = values.length > 1;
  const vertical = orientation === 'vertical';
  const opts = { min, max, step, minStepsBetweenThumbs };

  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, rootRef);
  const thumbs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
  const drag = useRef<{ index: number; offset: number; pointerId: number } | null>(null);
  const latest = useRef(values);
  latest.current = values;
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const change = (next: number[]) => {
    if (!sameValues(next, latest.current)) setRaw(next);
  };

  const moveTo = (index: number, clientX: number, clientY: number, offset: number) => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    const thumb = thumbs.current[index];
    if (!root || !thumb) return;
    const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ratio = pointerToRatio({
      pointer: vertical ? clientY : clientX,
      trackStart: vertical ? rect.top : rect.left,
      trackLength: vertical ? rect.height : rect.width,
      thumbSize: vertical ? thumb.offsetHeight : thumb.offsetWidth,
      vertical,
      grabOffset: offset,
    });
    change(setThumbValue(latest.current, index, ratioToValue(ratio, min, max), opts));
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onPointerDown?.(e);
    if (disabled || e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0) return;
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const onThumb = (e.target as Element).closest<HTMLElement>('.ui-slider-thumb');
    let index = onThumb ? thumbs.current.indexOf(onThumb as HTMLDivElement) : -1;
    let offset = 0;
    if (index >= 0 && onThumb) {
      // Grabbed a thumb: keep the grab point so it does not jump under the pointer
      const box = onThumb.getBoundingClientRect();
      offset = vertical ? e.clientY - (box.top + box.height / 2) : e.clientX - (box.left + box.width / 2);
    } else {
      const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      const thumbSize = (vertical ? thumbs.current[0]?.offsetHeight : thumbs.current[0]?.offsetWidth) ?? 0;
      const ratio = pointerToRatio({
        pointer: vertical ? e.clientY : e.clientX,
        trackStart: vertical ? rect.top : rect.left,
        trackLength: vertical ? rect.height : rect.width,
        thumbSize,
        vertical,
      });
      index = nearestThumb(latest.current, ratioToValue(ratio, min, max));
    }
    try {
      root.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      /* synthetic pointers cannot be captured */
    }
    drag.current = { index, offset, pointerId: e.pointerId };
    setDragging(index);
    thumbs.current[index]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    moveTo(index, e.clientX, e.clientY, offset);
    if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') e.preventDefault();
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onPointerMove?.(e);
    const d = drag.current;
    if (d && d.pointerId === e.pointerId) moveTo(d.index, e.clientX, e.clientY, d.offset);
  };

  const endDrag = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (!d || d.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
    drag.current = null;
    setDragging(null);
    try {
      rootRef.current?.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      /* already released */
    }
    onValueCommit?.(latest.current);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, index: number) => {
    if (disabled || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const gap = minStepsBetweenThumbs * step;
    const target = keyToValue(e.key, values[index]!, {
      min,
      max,
      step,
      lowerBound: index > 0 ? values[index - 1]! + gap : min,
      upperBound: index < values.length - 1 ? values[index + 1]! - gap : max,
    });
    if (target === undefined) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = setThumbValue(values, index, target, opts);
    if (next !== values) {
      change(next);
      onValueCommit?.(next);
    }
  };

  const gapSteps = minStepsBetweenThumbs * step;
  const fillStart = multi ? valueToRatio(values[0]!, min, max) : 0;
  const fillEnd = valueToRatio(values[values.length - 1]!, min, max);

  return (
    <div
      ref={composed}
      role={multi ? 'group' : undefined}
      aria-label={multi ? ariaLabel : undefined}
      aria-labelledby={multi ? labelledBy : undefined}
      data-orientation={orientation}
      data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
      data-dragging={dragging !== null ? '' : undefined}
      data-tooltip={tooltip}
      className={cn('ui-slider', className)}
      style={style}
      onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerUp={(e) => {
        onPointerUp?.(e);
        endDrag(e);
      }}
      onPointerCancel={(e) => {
        onPointerCancel?.(e);
        endDrag(e);
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="ui-slider-track" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="ui-slider-range" data-single={multi ? undefined : ''} style={{ '--ui-p-start': fillStart, '--ui-p-end': fillEnd } as CSSProperties} />
      </div>
      {values.map((v, i) => {
        const label = multi ? (thumbLabels?.[i] ?? (values.length === 2 ? (i === 0 ? 'Minimum' : 'Maximum') : `Value ${i + 1}`)) : ariaLabel;
        const text = formatValue(v);
        return (
          <div
            key={i}
            ref={(el) => {
              thumbs.current[i] = el;
            }}
            role="slider"
            tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
            aria-label={label}
            aria-labelledby={multi ? undefined : labelledBy}
            aria-orientation={orientation}
            aria-valuemin={i > 0 ? values[i - 1]! + gapSteps : min}
            aria-valuemax={i < values.length - 1 ? values[i + 1]! - gapSteps : max}
            aria-valuenow={v}
            aria-valuetext={text}
            aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
            data-dragging={dragging === i ? '' : undefined}
            className="ui-slider-thumb"
            style={{ '--ui-p': valueToRatio(v, min, max) } as CSSProperties}
            onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(e, i)}
          >
            {tooltip !== 'never' && (
              <span className="ui-slider-tooltip" aria-hidden="true">
                {text}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {name && !disabled && values.map((v, i) => <input key={i} type="hidden" name={name} value={v} />)}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/slider.css`

```css
/* Slider ------------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-slider" data-orientation="horizontal|vertical" [data-disabled] [data-dragging] data-tooltip="auto|always|never">
     <div class="ui-slider-track"><div class="ui-slider-range" style="--ui-p-start; --ui-p-end"></div></div>
     <div class="ui-slider-thumb" role="slider" style="--ui-p: 0–1" [data-dragging]>
       <span class="ui-slider-tooltip">
   The thumb centre travels (length − thumb); --ui-p is its 0–1 position on that span.
   Position is set with layout (not animated) so thumbs track the pointer exactly.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-slider {
    --ui-thumb: 1.25rem;
    --ui-rail: 0.375rem;
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--ui-thumb);
    touch-action: pan-y;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] {
    width: var(--ui-thumb);
    height: 12rem;
    touch-action: pan-x;
  }

  .ui-slider-track {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: var(--ui-rail);
    translate: 0 -50%;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-control-track);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-track {
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    width: var(--ui-rail);
    height: auto;
    translate: -50% 0;
  }
  .ui-slider-range {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block: 0;
    inset-inline-start: calc(var(--ui-thumb) / 2 + (100% - var(--ui-thumb)) * var(--ui-p-start, 0));
    inset-inline-end: calc(var(--ui-thumb) / 2 + (100% - var(--ui-thumb)) * (1 - var(--ui-p-end, 0)));
    background-color: var(--ui-control-on);
  }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-range {
    inset-inline: 0;
    inset-block-start: auto;
    inset-block-end: auto;
    bottom: calc(var(--ui-thumb) / 2 + (100% - var(--ui-thumb)) * var(--ui-p-start, 0));
    top: calc(var(--ui-thumb) / 2 + (100% - var(--ui-thumb)) * (1 - var(--ui-p-end, 0)));
  }

  .ui-slider-range[data-single] { inset-inline-start: 0; }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-range[data-single] { bottom: 0; }

  .ui-slider-thumb {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: calc(var(--ui-thumb) / 2 + (100% - var(--ui-thumb)) * var(--ui-p, 0));
    width: var(--ui-thumb);
    height: var(--ui-thumb);
    translate: -50% -50%;
    scale: 1;
    border: 2px solid var(--ui-control-on);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-control-thumb);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    outline: none;
    cursor: grab;
    transition:
      scale var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-thumb {
    top: auto;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: calc(var(--ui-thumb) / 2 + (100% - var(--ui-thumb)) * var(--ui-p, 0));
    translate: -50% 50%;
  }
  .ui-slider-thumb[data-dragging] { scale: 1.12; cursor: grabbing; }
  .ui-slider-thumb:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-slider-thumb:hover:not([data-dragging]) { scale: 1.06; }
  }

  /* Value bubble */
  .ui-slider-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: calc(100% + 0.5rem);
    left: 50%;
    translate: -50% 4px;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background-color: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle));
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-in),
      translate var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-in),
      filter var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-in);
  }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-tooltip {
    bottom: auto;
    left: calc(100% + 0.5rem);
    top: 50%;
    translate: -4px -50%;
  }
  .ui-slider-thumb:focus-visible .ui-slider-tooltip,
  .ui-slider-thumb[data-dragging] .ui-slider-tooltip,
  .ui-slider[data-tooltip="always"] .ui-slider-tooltip {
    opacity: 1;
    translate: -50% 0;
    filter: none;
    transition-duration: var(--ui-duration);
    transition-timing-function: var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-thumb:focus-visible .ui-slider-tooltip,
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-slider-thumb[data-dragging] .ui-slider-tooltip,
  .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"][data-tooltip="always"] .ui-slider-tooltip { translate: 0 -50%; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-slider[data-tooltip="auto"] .ui-slider-thumb:hover .ui-slider-tooltip { opacity: 1; translate: -50% 0; filter: none; }
    .ui-slider[data-orientation="vertical"][data-tooltip="auto"] .ui-slider-thumb:hover .ui-slider-tooltip { translate: 0 -50%; }
  }

  /* Disabled */
  .ui-slider[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-slider[data-disabled] .ui-slider-thumb { cursor: not-allowed; }
}
```

## Usage

**Volume** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/slider/volume.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@/ui/components/slider';

export default function SliderVolume() {
  const labelId = useId();
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState([40]);

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-3">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between text-base">
        <span id={labelId} className="font-medium">
          Volume
        </span>
        <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{volume[0]}%</span>
      </div>
      <Slider aria-labelledby={labelId} value={volume} onValueChange={setVolume} name="volume" formatValue={(v) => `${v}%`} />
    </div>
  );
}
```
